methodology: Offline packaged HTML, real Runtime/SaveSession/localStorage and existing mouse/touch controls. Save fixtures, player placement, quota and visibility gates are test-only. Fixed Date is used only for isolated rejection/layout/rollback cases, never the full 120-second training. Scene render is observed, never replaced. 390x844 is touch/viewport emulation, not a real phone. Old-build controls assert existing rendered behavior, not the absence of a new API.
